unsupported: Founded as a local supplier to industrial and commercial customers in the region, the company has operated continuously from its Columbia base for nearly three decades, building a reputation as a reliable source for electrical materials across the central part of the state.
The company distributes a full line of electrical materials to industrial and commercial facilities, focusing on maintenance, construction, and operational needs.

Its primary business is the distribution of electrical materials to industrial and commercial facilities, and it maintains store hours Monday through Thursday from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. and Friday until 2:00 p.m., with after-hours sales available by arrangement to accommodate urgent requirements.

Electric Control & Supply serves industrial and commercial customers throughout the Midlands area of South Carolina, including industrial plants, commercial buildings, and contractors that require electrical supplies for ongoing operations and projects.
The company emphasizes its local ownership and long-standing community presence as key differentiators in the regional market, offering after-hours service to support customer schedules.
